name: generate_gemini_completion
title: Account-Less Google Gemini 4 Argon & 3.1 Pro Universal Text Generator
description: Generates text completions and structured reasoning across all 45 Google Gemini foundation models (Gemini 4 Argon, 3.1 Pro, 3.8 Flash) with zero Google account or API key required. Use when running single-turn reasoning, coding, or analytical prompts on a specific Gemini model; for delegating multi-step autonomous tasks that require remote tool execution, use execute_antigravity_agent instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'prompt' ('model' defaults to 'gemini-4-argon'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (250 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

prompt.description: Primary user instruction or reasoning prompt to send to the selected Gemini model.

model.description: Target Gemini foundation model identifier; defaults to 'gemini-4-argon' when omitted.
Gemini model identifier that executed the completion.

success.description: True when inference completed without upstream errors.

grounding_metadata.description: Optional citation metadata if search grounding was enabled.

annotations.title: Account-Less Google Gemini 4 Argon & 3.1 Pro Universal Text Generator

name: execute_antigravity_agent
title: Google Antigravity Multi-Step Autonomous Coding & Workflow Agent
description: Dispatches a complex engineering or operational task to Google's Antigravity autonomous agent for multi-step planning, tool orchestration, and verified execution. Use when solving multi-stage software engineering or workflow tasks that require autonomous planning; for compiling exhaustive multi-source literature and market research dossiers, use conduct_deep_research_investigation instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'input' ('execution_mode' defaults to 'autonomous_verified'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (500 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

input.description: High-level task objective and constraints for the Antigravity autonomous agent.

execution_mode.description: Autonomy policy for subtask execution; defaults to 'autonomous_verified' when omitted.

output.description: Synthesized final deliverable and action trace summary.

success.description: True when the agent completed all planned steps.

annotations.title: Google Antigravity Multi-Step Autonomous Coding & Workflow Agent

name: conduct_deep_research_investigation
title: Gemini Deep Research Pro Multi-Hop Investigative Analyst
description: Runs an iterative, multi-hop investigative research session via Gemini Deep Research Pro, cross-examining primary sources to produce a cited technical report. Use when investigating complex scientific, architectural, or market questions requiring deep multi-hop synthesis; for running a fast single-turn Google Search grounded fact lookup, use search_gemini_grounded_web instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'input' ('depth_tier' defaults to 'quick_synthesis'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (1000 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

input.description: Investigative research question, scope, and specific aspects to analyze.

depth_tier.description: Research breadth and citation density; defaults to 'exhaustive_report' when omitted.

output.description: Comprehensive multi-section investigative report with inline citations.

success.description: True when the research synthesis completed.

annotations.title: Gemini Deep Research Pro Multi-Hop Investigative Analyst

name: operate_computer_use_agent
title: Gemini Computer Use GUI & Browser Action Planner
description: Plans and executes OS-level desktop, browser DOM, and GUI coordinate actions (click, type, scroll, wait) using the Gemini Computer Use agent. Use when automating interactive web UIs or desktop workflows that lack a direct REST API; for running code-first API and terminal automation tasks, use execute_antigravity_agent instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'input' ('viewport_preset' defaults to 'desktop_1080p'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (800 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

input.description: UI automation goal and target webpage or application context.

viewport_preset.description: Target screen resolution for coordinate grounding; defaults to 'desktop_1080p' when omitted.

output.description: Executed UI action sequence and extracted screen state.

success.description: True when the UI workflow reached the target state.

steps_executed.description: Number of GUI interaction steps performed.

annotations.title: Gemini Computer Use GUI & Browser Action Planner

name: search_gemini_grounded_web
title: Google Search Grounded Real-Time Fact & Citation Engine
description: Answers factual queries with live Google Search grounding, returning verified up-to-date answers accompanied by source URLs and grounding metadata. Use when verifying live web facts, documentation updates, or current events in a single low-latency call; for querying geographic places, coordinates, directions, and local business data via Google Maps grounding, use search_gemini_grounded_maps instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'prompt' ('recency_bias' defaults to 'past_24h'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (200 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

prompt.description: Factual question or search query to ground against live Google Search results.

recency_bias.description: Temporal preference for search snippets; defaults to 'any_time' when omitted.

model.description: Gemini model used for grounded synthesis.

citations.description: Structured Google Search grounding chunks and source URLs.

annotations.title: Google Search Grounded Real-Time Fact & Citation Engine

name: search_gemini_grounded_maps
title: Google Maps Grounded Geospatial & Place Intelligence Engine

Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'prompt' ('distance_units' defaults to 'metric_km'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (250 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

name: compile_mpp_research_dossier

Use when generating a strict-JSON cited intelligence brief paid via Base USDC MPP session headers; for running long-form narrative research reports via L402 Lightning, use conduct_deep_research_investigation instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'research_topic' ('output_density' defaults to 'concise_5_points'), supports '?demo=true' or MPP (1000 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

query.description: Research topic or technical question to investigate and structure into JSON.

annotations.title: Base MPP Session-Metered Multi-Source Research Dossier Compiler

name: generate_gemini_embeddings

model.description: Gemini embedding model version; defaults to 'gemini-embedding-2' when omitted.
